## Scope

The audit covered 182 second reads taken during the quarter. It assessed the consistency of grading by comparing the first and second grades recorded for each set. The review was limited to the reads included in the audit sample and considered whether the two grades matched.

## Result

The first and second grades agreed in 68.1 per cent of sets reviewed. This result provides an overall measure of grading agreement for the audit period. Per-grader results are available in the attached spreadsheet. These results will be discussed privately with each grader to support review of individual performance and identify any matters requiring clarification or follow-up. The overall finding should be considered alongside those individual results when assessing grading quality and consistency.
